document.abstract: Images are reproduced on the motion-picture screen by processes made possible by the reflection of light from the subjects on the set to the film in the camera. The lighting equipment available for attaining dramatic and artistic effects is an important factor contributing to the success of a motion-picture production. Studio set lighting equipment over the past forty years has been influenced by ever-changing factors such as film characteristics, sound and various production techniques. Current equipment and considerations for future equipment are discussed.
